title: Bump setup-context cache key version when a cached dataclass changes shape
answers: I added a field to a setup context dataclass, do I need to bump the cache key?
Experiment setup context returns stale or broken cached TargetSurface after deploy
Why is experiment_setup_context cache key versioned?
body:
Setup-context sections are cached as pickled dataclasses (TargetSurface, etc.).
Enforced by convention in products/experiments/backend/setup_context.py:_cache_key (comment: bump the version whenever a cached dataclass changes shape).
If skipped, after deploy the cache restores old instances that lack the new field, so the serializer fails or returns wrong data.
Adding `libs_truncated` to TargetSurface moved the prefix from experiment_setup_context_v2_ to experiment_setup_context_v3_.
Any new field on a cached dataclass in setup_context.py needs the same bump.
